unit: WF4 Distil Sources registry provenance, content alignment and heading-anchored excerpting
description: The want phrase appears in the document but only in the contents listing, never as a heading, so there is nothing citable and the row is rejected.
why_it_exists: Execution 335: the stored excerpt was text.slice(0, 6000), which on a consolidated Act is the cover page and the table of contents. All four sources were graded RETRIEVED and handed to the drafter as four contents listings, while research_status read COMPLETE and source_ref_count satisfied the Approval Gate unsourced-law check. A draft could therefore assert s 13 of the Limitation Act having never been shown the text of s 13: right provenance, right citation, wrong content.
